scope: Versioned native Vulkan resource/material/failure-handling follow-up; previous 0fcdbdd evidence is preserved separately.

independent_delta_review.limits: Selected caller/resource-lifetime paths, not exhaustive state-space or hardware proof. No SDL/window bridge or serialized parser/model work was read or changed.
contracts: Shared and separate vertex/indirect ownership are nulled after release and buffers are destroyed before owned memory.
Required dedicated image allocations do not enter pooled/resident reuse; required attachments are isolated.
Readback image/memory remain owned across possibly pending command failure until completion/device-loss teardown.
Worker allocation/preparation exceptions still publish job completion; ordinary main-thread fallback remains available.
Unsupported extent/image-list states produce controlled errors; arbitrary live window resizing is not implemented.

core: Stop selected mandatory create/reset/idle operations before dependent calls on non-success; logging-only VK_CHECK remains unchanged.
Guard instance/device/surface enumeration and host-array allocations; preserve qboolean device-selection failures.
Required dedicated attachment allocation isolation and exact-image chains.
Capture allocation/bind/map/invalidate failure cleanup; restore source layout before CPU read; unmap successful mapping before release.
Persistent pending readback ownership, released at teardown after device-idle success or confirmed device loss.
Mandatory dedicated readback allocation via actual requirements2 helper.
Reject unsupported WSI extents and excessive image lists instead of unsupported clamping/truncation.
Free per-tess dedicated geometry/indirect memory after buffer destruction, preserve shared path.
resource_memory: Copy misaligned SPIR-V to aligned storage only when needed; validate shader input and stop failed module creation.
Honor mandatory dedicated image/buffer requirements; retain normal arena and legacy requirement paths.
Worker exceptions and enqueue-allocation failures preserve completion/fallback behavior.
Failed optional pipeline-cache creation/retry leaves a null cache and permits uncached pipelines.
material_runtime: Clamp negative entity-selected image animation index before signed modulo or one-shot access; valid selection paths preserved.
Fog S/T coordinates sanitized independently; finite control unchanged.
Stencil shadow color capacity covers original and extruded vertices; complete1000vertex/6000index volume preserves adjacent color bundles.
Weather outside-cache first frame restores CPU modelview and publishes restored MVP, like normal rendering path.
Descriptor allocation and storage/vertex/indirect map/bind failure stops initialization through actual VK_REQUIRE_SUCCESS helper.

Single storage uses actual dedicated requirements helper; vertex/indirect per-command dedicated allocations when required or requirements differ, preserving normal shared arena. Capacity reports legal requested buffer bytes.

before.qualification: Allocation-null baseline was not executed to avoid an intentional null-dereference process crash. Its corrected two partial-allocation paths pass on all after builds. The baseline CMake adapts only missing cleanup function declaration; assertions and before algorithms remain unchanged.

resource_memory.before: Five defect cases failed and four controls passed using three extracted before-fix functions. Worker and buffer-helper before outcomes are not established.

material_runtime.before: Twelve defect cases failed; six unchanged controls passed.

focused_verification.limits: Actual production functions/blocks with engine/Vulkan service stubs; fatal errors throw to model nonreturning imports. Core baseline deliberately excludes a null-allocation crash; this is not a universal OOM/device-loss or all-driver proof.

builds.summary: Full ordinary Windows x64/x86 builds passed for the frozen 81b10be source; root verified explicit native-command exit 0 for both architectures.
builds.qualification: The first logging wrapper returned 1 without a FAILED build line. Direct command rechecks exited 0 and the check logs report ninja: no work to do. The wrapper return is not used as a successful native-build exit.

gpu.summary: The six ordinary 81b10be GPU profiles passed (23 map loads, 50 captures), as did weather and the corrected bot-shadow acceptance run (six maps, 33 captures). SSAA/HDR failed real driver validation for refraction blit destination width and dynamic-glow clear rectangles; owned polling aborted the process, with configuration/runtime preserved. Fullscreen/debug cases are unrun, corrections are in progress, and 81b10be will not be deployed.
